function.name: find_supplier
function.description: Resolve the supplier named on the statement to its id. (A bare GET /api/suppliers 405s.) (GET /api/v2/suppliers)

filter[search].description: Supplier name or email from the statement.

function.name: get_supplier_statement
function.description: SKU.io's own statement for the supplier, in tenant currency. view=open_item (default) gives open_items[] (doc_type, id, number, supplier_invoice_number, purchase_order, date, due_date, total, total_paid, credits_applied, deposits_applied, outstanding_balance, status), credits[] (open, unapplied credits with `available`), deposits[] and totals{open, credits, deposits, net_payable}. view=activity gives opening/closing balance and lines[] (date, type, reference, debit, credit, running_balance; type invoice | bill | payment | credit_applied | credit_unapplied | deposit_applied | deposit_unapplied) for a date range. (GET /api/suppliers/{supplier}/statement)

date_to.description: ISO date, on or after date_from. Required when view=activity.

function.name: list_purchase_invoices
function.description: Every bill for the supplier, paid ones included (the statement only lists open ones). Rows carry supplier_invoice_number, purchase_invoice_date, calculated_total + tax_total (the gross total; there is no single total field), total_paid, outstanding_balance, status, payments[] and applied_vendor_credits[] (each with its allocation id and vendor_credit number). (GET /api/purchase-invoices)

filter[status].description: unpaid, partially_paid or paid. Omit for all.

filter[purchase_invoice_date.after].description: ISO date, to bound the window.

filter[search].description: Supplier invoice number, PO number or total. Pair with search_columns=supplier_invoice_number for an exact number lookup.

function.name: get_purchase_invoice
function.description: One bill with its lines, payments and applied credits, to compare with the supplier's invoice line by line. (GET /api/purchase-invoices/{purchaseInvoice})

purchaseInvoice.description: Purchase invoice id (not the supplier's invoice number).

function.name: list_invoice_payments
function.description: Payments recorded on one bill: id, amount, payment_date, payment_type, external_reference. An external_reference with a provider prefix (xero:…, qbo:…) means the payment was imported from the accounting system rather than recorded in SKU.io. (GET /api/purchase-invoices/{purchaseInvoiceId}/payments)

function.name: delete_invoice_payment
function.description: Remove one payment from a bill. Only for a proven duplicate; see the guardrails. (DELETE /api/purchase-invoices/{purchaseInvoiceId}/payments/{payment})

function.name: list_supplier_credits
function.description: The supplier's OPEN vendor credits only (remaining amount above zero). A fully applied credit is not listed; find those through each bill's applied_vendor_credits[]. (GET /api/vendor-credits/for-supplier/{supplier})

function.name: unapply_vendor_credit
function.description: Take a credit back off a bill. Reopens the credit, raises the bill's outstanding balance, and shows as credit_unapplied on the activity statement. The allocation id is applied_vendor_credits[].id on the bill. (DELETE /api/vendor-credits/{vendor_credit}/allocations/{vendor_credit_allocation})

function.name: apply_credits_to_bill
function.description: Apply one or more open credits to one bill in a single all-or-nothing call. (POST /api/vendor-credits/allocate-batch)

allocated_at.description: ISO date the credit was used, normally the payment date.

notes.description: Why (max 1000 chars), e.g. the bank reference of the payment that used it.

function.name: suggest_payment_allocation
function.description: The supplier's open bills oldest-due first, with `total` spread across them greedily. A starting point only; it is not how the supplier applied the money. (GET /api/purchase-invoices/supplier-payments/allocation-suggestion)

function.name: list_supplier_payments
function.description: Supplier payments recorded in SKU.io (one payment across several bills), newest first. (GET /api/purchase-invoices/supplier-payments)

function.name: list_payment_types
function.description: Resolve payment_type_id by name (e.g. "Bank Transfer", "ACH"). Don't invent the id. (GET /api/v2/payment-types)

function.name: record_supplier_payment
function.description: Record money that already left the bank as one payment across one or more bills. Credits cannot be part of it: apply them to the bills first, then pay the net. Each allocation must not exceed the bill's outstanding balance; all bills must share a currency. (POST /api/purchase-invoices/supplier-payments)

payment_date.description: The date the bank line cleared, ISO.

payment_type_id.description: From list-payment-types. Omitted, it falls back to "Cash".

external_reference.description: The bank line's own reference (ACH/wire number), so the payment can be traced.

allocations.description: Each { purchase_invoice_id, amount } (or bill_id for a non-PO bill).

function.name: delete_supplier_payment
function.description: Reverse a supplier payment recorded in SKU.io (and its accounting-system batch, if it was pushed). (DELETE /api/purchase-invoices/supplier-payments/{supplierPaymentId})
